cards.title: Indicator 13: externalRatingChangeWl(previous, current) on notchChange
cards.context: REQ-03-13. Add src/indicators/externalRating.mjs with the named export externalRatingChangeWl(previous, current) → 0 | 1 | 2. Import notchChange from ../ratings/notch.mjs (positive = downgrade) and copy no scale. Thresholds: notches >= 3 → 2, notches === 2 → 1, else 0. These are NOT the Indicator 12 thresholds in countryRating.mjs. A RangeError from notchChange propagates unchanged with no fallback. Pure function, no I/O, no deps (CLAUDE.md). Change no existing file (notch.mjs, countryRating.mjs, existing tests). Follow the style of src/indicators/countryRating.mjs: header comment with REQ id, named function export. Unit tests use node:test + node:assert/strict like test/unit/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs.
acceptance: AC-7: named export externalRatingChangeWl from src/indicators/externalRating.mjs; imports only notchChange from ../ratings/notch.mjs, no copy of the scale
AC-3: 1-notch downgrade, unchanged, upgrade → 0 (BBB+→BBB = 0; AA→AA = 0; BB→BBB = 0; CCC-→AAA = 0)
AC-1/2/3: all 361 ordered pairs equal d>=3?2:d===2?1:0; counts WL1=17, WL2=136, WL0=208
AC-5: any rating not on the scale throws RangeError, no WL ('X','A'; 'A','X'; '','A'; null,'A'; 'BBB' alone; 'BBB','D'; 'NR','BBB'; 'Baa1','BBB'; 5,'A')
AC-7: result is a number in {0,1,2}, never string/boolean/object
AC-6: only the three new files change; npm test passes with all existing tests unchanged
